issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): disk_footprint and commit_repair splits import 20 private helpers across new modules
issue.description:
`just check` / `just symvision` fails at `lint (symvision)` on main `74d532a22d` with
"Private functions/classes should not be imported" for 20 underscore-private helpers.
The helpers are imported across sibling modules created by two recent toobig module
splits:

- `620d872547 refactor(core): split disk footprint module`, which created
  `src/sase/core/disk_footprint_inventory.py`, `disk_footprint_reap.py` and
  `disk_footprint_utils.py`: `_artifact_run_reap_step`, `_cargo_stray_rows`,
  `_du_size`, `_is_cargo_target_root`, `_is_repo_checkout`, `_managed_tmp_reap_step`,
  `_managed_tmp_rows`, `_orphan_proc_runtime_summary`, `_proc_runtime_reap_step`,
  `_resolve_sase_core_dir`, `_rust_target_rows`, `_sase_state_rows`,
  `_tree_size_walk`, `_workspace_compact_steps`, `_workspace_project_keys`,
  `_workspace_rows`.
- `2863ed2f19` / `4cd297ada2 refactor(finalizers): split commit finalizer/repair
  helpers`, which created `src/sase/finalizers/commit_repair_common.py` and
  `commit_repair_conflict.py`: `_ConflictRepairResult`, `_artifact_label`,
  `_bound_stream`, `_run_conflict_repair_turn`.

Root cause: the split agents moved private helpers into new sibling modules but kept
their leading underscores while importing them across module boundaries. Their own
`just check` runs never reached the symvision gate, because `lint (feature flags)`
failed earlier on the sase.pager circular import (sase-10k, fixed by `74d532a22d`). Now
that the feature-flag gate is green, symvision surfaces these violations for every agent.

Remediation, following the same pattern `74d532a22d` used for the
`run_agent_wait_slot_candidate/state` split: make each cross-module helper public (drop
the underscore and update its importers), or move a helper back into the only module
that uses it. Do not add pragmas or whitelist entries to silence the gate. Upstream
`6218d1585d refactor(llm_provider): split continuation_budget.py` landed afterwards from
the same toobig batch, so re-run `just symvision` on current master and include any
private imports it adds.

Found by the sase-zt.6.5.4 land agent while verifying the post-landing symvision
whitelist; it is unrelated to queue-capacity work.

Reproduce:

    just install && just symvision

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Symvision is a static whole-repo analysis; it failed identically on repeated just symvision runs on main 74d532a22d with a clean working tree, naming the same 20 private symbols each time.

payload.entry: RELATED (recorded as a note because sase artifact link add was refused: the hidden plans clone at ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/plans has uncommitted changes that belong to another agent): sase-zk is the same failure class (private helpers imported across split update_handler modules), a separate defect with the same remediation. sase-10k is the sase.pager circular import that failed lint (feature flags) and masked this gate from the split agents' own just check runs; 74d532a22d fixed it. sase-z4.6.5.4.6.3 appears in the SASE_BEAD trailers of 620d872547 and 2863ed2f19, but those are toobig module splits, so the trailer looks inherited rather than causal.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction while splitting src/sase/monitor/start.py on 2026-09-14: after the monitor-specific Symvision private imports were fixed, both `just _lint-symvision` and the required `just check` still fail at lint (symvision) only on the existing disk_footprint and commit_repair private imports listed on this task. Focused monitor-start tests pass, so this remains an unrelated whole-repo verification blocker.
